$comment: Licence policy of the admin's production npm dependencies, checked by `npm run licenses` (the `Admin licenses` CI job, ADR 0022 §4, ADR 0012 §4). It follows deny.toml's rule: only licences that may be combined with AGPL-3.0-only, each with its reason. The list holds the licences of the real production tree at bootstrap; adding one needs a PR that states the reason. `exceptions` allow a licence for one package only, like deny.toml's CDLA-Permissive-2.0 exception for webpki-roots. FSF = https://www.gnu.org/licenses/license-list.html.

allow.reason: The Expat licence: on the FSF list of GPL-compatible free software licences, so it combines with AGPL-3.0-only. Also on deny.toml's list.
On the FSF list of GPL-compatible free software licences. Also on deny.toml's list.
The FreeBSD licence: on the FSF list of GPL-compatible free software licences. Also on deny.toml's list.
The Modified BSD licence: on the FSF list of GPL-compatible free software licences. Also on deny.toml's list.
FSF: compatible with GPL version 3, and therefore combinable with AGPL-3.0-only. Also on deny.toml's list.

FSF: GPL-compatible through its secondary-licence clause (MPL-2.0 §3.3). The 'Incompatible With Secondary Licenses' variant has its own SPDX id, MPL-2.0-no-copyleft-exception, which is not allowed. Brought in by lightningcss, the CSS compiler of Vite and Tailwind. Also on deny.toml's list.
The Zero-clause BSD licence: on the FSF list of GPL-compatible free software licences; it grants every permission without conditions. Used by tslib, which ships in the bundle through cmdk's dialog.

The Blue Oak Model License 1.0.0, an OSI-approved permissive licence that the FSF list does not name. It grants copyright and patent permission on one condition, that recipients get the licence text or a link to it, the same notice duty as MIT, so nothing in it conflicts with AGPL-3.0-only. Used by isexe and minimatch, build tooling of the shadcn package.

exceptions.reason: The Inter variable font that the shadcn base-vega preset imports; its font files ship in admin/dist. FSF lists the SIL Open Font License 1.1 as a free licence for fonts. The font files are separate works served beside the program, an aggregate under AGPL-3.0 §5, not combined with it. Scoped to this package so that no code can arrive under a font licence.

Browser-support data that browserslist reads at build time (through the shadcn package's tooling); none of it is bundled. FSF: CC BY 4.0 is compatible with all versions of the GNU GPL. It is a licence for data, not software, so it is scoped to this package.
